title: Start with Xavier’s email
caption: Open Xavier’s email on your iPhone. Find the Kingdoms & Dragons app link. Keep Wi-Fi or mobile data on.

title: Open the app link
caption: Tap the app link once. If it opens in Safari, continue to the app page. If it opens in another browser or inside email, follow the next steps.

title: If needed: copy the link
caption: Return to the email. Touch and hold the app link, then choose Copy Link or Copy. The link is now ready to paste.

title: Open Safari
caption: Find Safari, the blue compass icon. Tap it. Use Safari for this iPhone installation walkthrough.

title: Paste the app address
caption: Tap Safari’s address bar. Touch and hold inside it, then tap Paste and Go. If you see Paste instead, tap Paste, then Go.

title: Check the journey page
caption: Wait for Kingdoms & Dragons to load. You should see the journey title. If the app was already open in Safari, start here.

title: Find the Share button
caption: Tap Share: a square with an upward arrow. Depending on Safari’s layout, first tap the Page Menu, then Share.

title: Expand the Share sheet
caption: Swipe upward on the Share sheet to reveal more actions. Look below the row of app icons for Add to Home Screen.

title: Tap Add to Home Screen
caption: Tap Add to Home Screen. If it is missing, scroll to Edit Actions, then add the Add to Home Screen action.

title: Check the app options
caption: Keep the suggested name K&D102. If Open as Web App appears, leave it switched on. Older iPhones may not show that switch.

title: Tap Add
caption: Tap Add in the upper-right corner. Wait for the new icon to be placed on this iPhone’s Home Screen.

title: Find your new app icon
caption: Return to the Home Screen: swipe up from the bottom, or press the physical Home button. Swipe between pages to find K&D102.

title: Open your journey
caption: Tap the new app icon. Use it each day instead of finding the email again. Travelers do not need Xavier’s TD Login. Keep internet on for current updates.

title: If you need a little help
caption: Cannot find the icon? Swipe down on the Home Screen and search its name. If installation did not finish, reopen the link in Safari and repeat Share → Add to Home Screen.
